Archive Records As JSON.description: Uploads incoming records to a bucket as a JSON object, e.g. a raw data lake landing zone.

Export Report As CSV.description: Uploads rows as a CSV file with custom metadata.

Create Bucket.description: Creates a new bucket, optionally with object locking.

Tag Object As Processed.description: Sets tags on an object, e.g. to mark it processed after a pipeline step.

List Objects By Prefix.description: Lists objects under a prefix, e.g. today's uploads.

Get JSON Object.description: Downloads an object and parses it as JSON.

Get CSV Object.description: Downloads a CSV file and parses it into rows.

Get Object Tags.description: Reads the tags on an object, e.g. to check its processing status.
Get Object Tags.code:
// Check an object's tags before processing it.
getObjectTags('raw-health-data', $.data.objectName);
